title: AI4 conference to showcase enterprise AI #AI4 #enterpriseAI #GeoffreyHinton
description: AI4 expanded its exhibitor base from 225 to nearly 400, transforming from a conference with keynote insights by Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng into a dynamic live marketplace for enterprise AI solutions. Major industry players like AMD, NVIDIA, AWS, Google Cloud, Mistral AI, and IBM showcased transformative technologies alongside a rapidly growing Startup Alley. This growth highlights a market shift towards hands-on demonstrations and real-time business opportunities over theoretical discussions. For enterprises buying, building, or investing in AI, AI4 offers a unique environment to compare technologies and forge strategic partnerships in one concentrated venue. The evolution of AI4 reflects broader trends in AI commercialization and the increasing relevance of agentic AI and humanoid robotics, signaling a new phase where practical applications drive industry momentum. #AI4 #GeoffreyHinton #FeiFeiLi #AndrewNg #EnterpriseAI #AIMarketplace #AMDAI #NVIDIAAI #AWSAI #GoogleCloudAI #MistralAI #IBMAI #StartupAlley #HumanoidRobotics #AgenticAI
